description: Create the ad itself — the object that binds a POST (the creative) to an AD GROUP (the targeting and budget). Create the post first with create_reddit_ads_post and pass its id as postId; without a post there is nothing to show. A CATALOG ad (an ad group with a productSetId under a SALES useCatalog campaign) has no post: pass shoppingCreative (headline, callToAction, optional destinationUrl, secondLineCta PRICE/DESCRIPTION, dpaCarouselMode, heroCard for a collection ad) plus redditProfileId, and optionally up to 6 productIds to feature. ALWAYS created PAUSED, and Reddit additionally has to APPROVE it, so a fresh ad reports effective status PENDING_APPROVAL — report that rather than calling it live. UTMs: clickUrlQueryParameters ({"utm_source":"reddit","utm_campaign":"{{CAMPAIGN_ID}}"} — Reddit macros allowed, ≤14) are appended to the click URL by Reddit — Reddit allows that list only on some campaigns and otherwise refuses “URL Parameters cannot be added to this campaign”; then write the parameters into clickUrl itself. PREVIEW: previewDays (1-30) asks Reddit for a preview link, read back as previewUrl (the very first time, Reddit wants the test URL generated once in Ads Manager — the reply says so). GOTCHA: a TEXT ("free form") post’s ad may not carry clickUrl at all — Reddit refuses it. The click destination for image and link ads lives on the POST’s media destinationUrl, not here.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

adGroupId.description: the ad group whose targeting and budget this ad runs under

clickUrl.description: leave unset for TEXT-post ads — Reddit rejects "Free form ads cannot have a click url"

clickUrlQueryParameters.description: UTM / tracking parameters Reddit appends to the click URL, e.g. {"utm_source":"reddit","utm_medium":"paid","utm_content":"{{AD_ID}}"} — up to 14

eventTrackers.description: third-party measurement URLs; only Reddit-approved providers are accepted

type.description: CLICK or VIEW: when the third-party tracker fires

url.description: third-party measurement URL from a Reddit-approved provider

postId.description: the post to promote (t3_…) from create_reddit_ads_post or list_reddit_ads_posts — required except for a catalog ad built from shoppingCreative

previewDays.description: 1-30: switch on a preview link that stays valid this many days

productIds.description: catalog ads: up to 6 product ids to feature

redditProfileId.description: the post author profile — required for catalog sales campaigns

allowComments.description: true allows comments on the catalog ad

callToAction.description: Reddit’s exact CTA text, e.g. "Shop Now"

dpaCarouselMode.description: AUTO, CAROUSEL_ONLY or CAROUSEL_DISABLED for the product carousel

heroCard.description: makes it a collection ad with an intro card

destinationUrl.description: where a click on the collection intro card goes

imageUrl.description: public image URL for the collection intro card

secondLineCta.description: PRICE or DESCRIPTION: text on the second line of the ad

name: create_reddit_ads_ad
title: Create a Reddit ad
